_note: Fetch-and-score social-signal tool. Load-bearing intent: per-lane ranking (never a merged score); optional lanes (X/YouTube) degrade VISIBLY without crashing; it FETCHES a digest, it does NOT synthesize prose (that's deep-research); depth changes per-lane N; the header surfaces per-lane counts so a failed/empty lane is visible. These are exercised deterministically by tests/ (test_*.py); the eval cases below check the skill triggers and stays in its lane vs deep-research/WebSearch.

evals.name: fetches-digest-not-a-synthesized-report
evals.prompt: What are people saying about the new React compiler in the last 30 days?
evals.expected_output: Runs last30d/scripts/last30d.py with the topic and presents the per-lane engagement-ranked digest (Reddit/HN/GitHub/arXiv, X and YouTube if available). It does NOT hand-write a prose report from its own knowledge — the digest is the deliverable; any synthesis is clearly derived from the fetched items with their links/scores.

assertions.text: invokes the last30d script rather than answering from model knowledge
produces a per-lane digest (not a single merged ranked list)

evals.name: optional-lanes-skip-visibly-not-crash
evals.prompt: last30d on 'homelab networking' — I don't have an xAI key or yt-dlp installed.
evals.expected_output: The run completes; Reddit/HN/GitHub/arXiv return results while the X section shows 'skipped: no XAI_API_KEY' and YouTube shows 'skipped: yt-dlp not installed'. It does not abort or error out over the missing optional dependencies.

assertions.text: X and YouTube render a visible skip line; other lanes still produce results
the run does not crash due to the missing key/CLI

evals.name: stays-in-lane-vs-deep-research
evals.prompt: 幫我對「臺灣 IPv6 部署」做一份完整查證、附引用的研究報告。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this asks for a web-verified CITED report, which is deep-research's job, not last30d. Either points to / hands off to deep-research, or clarifies — it does not pretend last30d's engagement digest is a cited research report. If it does fetch social signal, it frames it as input to the report, not the report itself. Responds in Traditional Chinese.

assertions.text: does not present last30d's social digest as a cited verified report
routes the cited-report request to deep-research

evals.name: depth-controls-breadth
evals.prompt: Give me a deep last30d scan on 'RISC-V', top 50 per source.
evals.expected_output: Passes --depth deep so each lane returns up to 50 items (not the default 25).

assertions.text: uses --depth deep (N=50) rather than the default
